answers.core:
How would an asset know what and when to pause? IIRC it needs core changes, plus assets can't add to project settings AFAIK.

Original issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/16397

ETA: It seems that the animated sprites and tiles suffer from the same problem, and especially for tiles, the workaround would be very involved.
answers.workaround: While this is possible by setting emitting to false on particles, it requires attaching a tool script to EVERY particle emitter. The bigger the project, the less feasible this gets.

title: Add ability to pause all animated content within the editor (implemented in 3.5, not ported to `master` yet)
